title: tHRR-I-PMData: development and external construct evaluation of a bounded tail-sensitive heart-rate-reserve index
description: Reproducible code, frozen derived results, protocols, and figures for exploratory PMData method development and locked external construct evaluation in WEEE and the University of Malaga treadmill dataset. The release includes selection-aware PMData analyses, a matching negative control, repeated-measures WEEE analyses, device agreement with uncertainty, synchronization audits, and Malaga endpoint and anchor sensitivity analyses. Original code is licensed under the MIT License. Third-party raw data are not redistributed.
